Date: Sun, 12 Jul 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Request: staff training & background-check artifacts for SIG/C A I Q mapping

Hi Priya,

Thanks for the call earlier — Helix is progressing through vendor SIG and CAIQ mapping and our security team has a couple of follow-ups specific to personnel controls. Can you send a small set of representative artifacts that demonstrate: 

- mandatory security awareness training (matrix + a sample certificate)
- background-check practice (redacted examples and scope)
- onboarding/offboarding timeline for access provisioning and deprovisioning (example ticket or csv)

We don’t need full employee records — a redacted sample set and a one-paragraph process description are sufficient for this stage. Targeting completion by EOD Tuesday if that’s feasible.

Thanks,
Hanna Lowell
Security Analyst, Helix Health
sec-questions@helixhealth.com

---
Note: we will reference these artifacts in the SIG questionnaire (Sections 5.1–5.4)

Hanna — thanks for the clear list. We can provide redacted samples and a short process summary. Quick clarifying Qs:

1) For the background checks, do you want pre-employment checks only, or also market/case-by-case rechecks for elevated roles?
2) Is a short CSV export of access deprovision timestamps (redacted by user id) acceptable for the offboarding timeline?

Ben, Marcus — can one of you assemble the sample artifacts and the one-paragraph process note? I’ll review and send to Helix.

I’ll target a first pass by Tuesday morning. If Helix needs additional attestation language for SIG answer fields we can append.

Best,

Priya — putting the samples together now. Delivered items (attached):

- onboarding-training-matrix.pdf — shows required training cadence by role (new hire, quarterly refresh, role-specific modules)
- bg-check-samples-redacted.pdf — two anonymized pre-employment reports, redacted PII, show scope and vendor attestation
- offboard-timeline.csv — example export with deprovision timestamps for 3 sample exits (user ids redacted to uid-###)

Process note (short): "Redwood requires identity verification and vendor-conducted pre-employment background checks for hires in security-sensitive roles. Training is mandatory on day 1 and tracked in our LMS; access requests are tied to role-based entitlements and deprovisioning is automated via HR ticketing with a daily reconciliation job."

I’ve attached the files to this thread and uploaded a limited-access Drive folder. Let me know if you need signed attestations from HR or a redaction checklist.

-Ben
